newsitem.title: CHINA: China to redeem maturing state debt on Monday.
newsitem.headline: China to redeem maturing state debt on Monday.

text.p: China will launch the redemption of state debt maturing in 1997 next Monday with the one-year Treasury bill issued in early 1996, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.
The one-year discount bills would be redeemed at their face value of 100 yuan against an issue price of 89.2 yuan, the newspaper quoted an announcement by the Finance Ministry as saying.

The announcement said other state debt for redemption in 1997 included five-year bonds issued to individuals and institutions in 1992, three-year notes issued to personal investors in 1994 and another batch of one-year bills issued to the public in April 1996.
The ministry did not give a figure for the total amount of state debt to be redeemed in 1997.
A spokesman for the ministry declined to give figures and said they would be made public later.
